connector.name: Loyaltyvip
connector.registryDescription: U.S. casino directory + a player's loyalty data, comps, tiers, and gambling tax docs.
connector.summary: Hosted at loyaltyvip.com over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the justinmont84 account. Treat it as community software and read the source before granting access to anything sensitive.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: LOYALTYVIP_API_KEY
env.description: Personal API key (lvip_live_...). Optional; needed only for a player's own data.
